scenario: institute webmail mailbox is over quota, log in to request more storage
subject: Your IIT Hyderabad Webmail Quota Is Over Quota/Limit
body:
Dear [Student Name],

This is a reminder that your IIT Hyderabad webmail quota has been exceeded. To avoid permanent account suspension, you must immediately request additional storage by clicking the link below.

Failure to act quickly will result in restricted access to your mailbox and potential data loss. Please click the link to validate and increase your quota now.

[Click Here: https://portal.training.invalid/verify]

Thank you for your immediate attention to this matter.

IT SUPPORT TEAM

IIT HYDERABAD
